title: Targeting ZMYND8 unleashes IL-2 signalling to override T cell exhaustion.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: GEO SuperSeries GSE342764 (mouse) lists 7 SubSeries: scRNA-seq (4 samples), bulk ATAC-seq (16, one summary xlsx), single-cell multiome (8), scCRISPR GSE339143 (10), and three CUT&RUN sets. Downloaded all five scCRISPR 10x h5 matrices (23-38 MB each) plus the guide reference CSV: 48,316 cells total, 32,285 genes plus 330 guide features (99 target genes x 3 guides + 30 non-targeting guides; target Ensembl IDs given). Guide capture is shallow (median 1-2 guide UMIs per cell); a crude rule (top guide >=5 UMIs and >=80% of guide UMIs) assigns only 11,550 cells, roughly 110 per target gene. No per-cell guide calls, cluster labels or cell-state annotations are deposited in the scCRISPR SubSeries.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Abstract only (paywalled, no PMC full text): in vivo scCRISPR screen of epigenetic factors and IL-2 regulators in P14 cells during chronic LCMV (lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus) infection, day 28 per GEO design text. Paper's own cell counts, guide-assignment thresholds and state definitions were not seen.

a1_downloadable.note: Checked in files: GEO processed h5 matrices and guide reference download openly, no login.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Checked in files: guide UMI counts are in the matrix, but no guide calls or cell-state labels are deposited; the outcome (exhaustion state per cell, or a per-perturbation effect) must be built by guide assignment plus clustering, i.e. constructed.

a3_inputs_present.note: Checked in files: expression counts and guide sequences/target Ensembl IDs are present.

a4_units_stated.note: Checked in files: raw UMI counts from Cell Ranger, standard units.

a5_enough_rows.note: Checked in files: the independent unit for perturbation-effect prediction is the target gene, 99 genes (+ non-targeting control), far under 400; 48,316 cells but only ~11,550 confidently guide-assigned by my crude rule.

a6_fits_laptop.note: Checked in files: loads in seconds on a laptop.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Not checkable: paper full text unavailable; GEO sample counts are internally consistent (5 h5 matrices for 5 gene-expression libraries).

a8_label_provenance.note: Measured: expression is direct sequencing readout; perturbation is the delivered guide. Not a model output.

backbone.name: scGPT or Geneformer (single-cell foundation models) would be the natural fit

integration.partner_dataset: GSE216797, the same St Jude lab's 2023 in vivo tumour scCRISPR screen (Zhou et al., Nature 2023), found by search but not opened
integration.join_key: mouse gene symbol / Ensembl gene of the perturbed target
integration.bigger_question_one_sentence: Do knockout effects measured in T cells during chronic viral infection predict the same knockouts' effects in tumour-infiltrating T cells?

controls.positive_control: Zmynd8, Tcf7, Tox and Prdm1 knockouts should shift cell states in the directions the paper and literature report.

honest_claim_h3: At best: predicts how knocking out one of ~99 chromatin and transcription regulators shifts mouse virus-specific CD8+ T cell states in one infection model, from one lab.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use the identity of a knocked-out gene to predict how mouse killer T cells' gene expression changes during chronic viral infection.
plain_idea.train_on: Single-cell expression profiles of 48,316 mouse T cells, each carrying a guide RNA that knocks out one of 99 genes; ~11,550 cells could be confidently assigned a guide by a crude rule.
plain_idea.predict: The shift in expression or cell-state proportions caused by each knockout, measured by single-cell RNA sequencing and compared with non-targeting control cells.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Immunotherapy labs choosing which genes to delete in engineered T cells could prioritise knockouts without running mouse screens; but with 99 perturbations there is too little to learn from.

ml_idea: Perturbation-response prediction (unseen knockout -> expression shift) or cross-context transfer (infection screen -> tumour screen). Dead at A5: only 99 perturbed genes, and no deposited guide calls or state labels.

effort.compute_note: Matrices loaded with h5py/scipy in seconds; guide assignment and clustering would need ~a day to reproduce the paper's states.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Count perturbed genes with >=50 confidently assigned cells and a significant shift from non-targeting controls; already shows only 99 targets total.

verdict_reason: Fails A5 and A2: the unit for learning is the perturbed gene (99 targets), and the outcome (cell state per cell or per knockout) must be constructed from shallow guide counts (median 1-2 UMIs) and clustering, since no guide calls or annotations are deposited.
